### 🔵 Needs a closer look It changes a security boundary (which directories an authenticated client may browse, including the credential/config deny-list) across server, protocol, and dashboard, which warrants final human review.
1 open issue - [Missing symlink-support skip guard for symlink-using suite](https://github.com/blamechris/chroxy/pull/8671#discussion_r4308490208) · New
What changed in this PR This PR makes the dashboard's directory-browsing path (`list_directory`) honour the same resolved-cwd policy that explicit session creation already uses (`validateCwdAllowed`), instead of the older "restricted to $HOME" rule. Configured workspace roots and permitted defaults are now browsable outside `$HOME`, while outside paths and credential/config directories stay denied. It also adds an optional `requestId` nonce so the dashboard can correlate a prefill-check reply even when the server normalizes the path, and surfaces a startup warning plus a pre-Browse note when a configured default cwd would be rejected. **Changes:** - Extract `validateResolvedCwdAllowed` and apply it (via a canonical-path predicate) to directory browsing for both success and error-classification paths, forwarding runtime `config` from the handler. - Thread an optional `requestId` through the `list_directory`/`directory_listing` protocol, store-core, dashboard store, and `usePathAutocomplete` for safe reply correlation; add `warnInvalidDefaultCwd` startup diagnostic and a `CreateSessionModal` prefill note. - Add server and dashboard test suites plus protocol/store-core coverage. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | packages/​server/​src/​handler-utils.js | Splits out `validateResolvedCwdAllowed` for canonical paths without an existence check. | | packages/​server/​src/​ws-file-ops/​browser.js | Applies the shared cwd policy + predicate, config-driven home/default, and optional `requestId` echo. | | packages/​server/​src/​ws-file-ops/​common.js | Lets `unresolvablePathError`/`isUnresolvablePathWithin` accept a predicate boundary. | | packages/​server/​src/​handlers/​file-handlers.js | Forwards `ctx.services.config` and `msg.requestId` to `listDirectory`. | | packages/​server/​src/​server-cli.js | Adds `warnInvalidDefaultCwd` and calls it from the daemon factory. | | packages/​server/​src/​ws-server.js | Documents the new `requestId` field in the outbound roster JSDoc. | | packages/​protocol/​src/​schemas/​client.ts, server/​file-ops.ts (+dist) | Adds optional `requestId` to list/listing schemas. | | packages/​store-core/​src/​handlers/​file.ts | Parses optional `requestId` into `DirectoryListingPayload`. | | packages/​dashboard/​src/​hooks/​usePathAutocomplete.ts | Adds prefill check + nonce-based reply correlation. | | packages/​dashboard/​src/​components/​CreateSessionModal.tsx | Surfaces the prefilled-directory "not browsable" note. | | packages/​dashboard/​src/​store/​{connection.ts,types.ts} | Forwards `requestId` through `requestDirectoryListing`. | | tests (server/​dashboard/​protocol/​store-core) | New/updated coverage for policy, correlation, and diagnostics. |
Review effort: Balanced
